Finding the right coaching institute is one of the most important decisions for a student’s academic success. A strong foundation, experienced faculty, regular assessments, and concept-based learning can make all the difference in helping students achieve their goals.

At Mayank Tutorials, Chembur Naka, we provide structured coaching for SSC, ICSE, 11th & 12th Science, and 11th & 12th Commerce students. We also offer dedicated preparation for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET, and MHT-CET, helping students balance board exams with competitive entrance preparation.

📍 Visit our Chembur Naka centre to learn more about our courses and admissions for the current academic year.

WHY ACTIVE RECALL IS ONE OF THE BEST STUDY METHODS FOR STUDENTS

Many students spend hours re-reading textbooks and highlighting notes, believing that more reading automatically leads to better marks. However, one of the most effective study methods is active recall, where students test themselves instead of repeatedly reading the same material.

Active recall strengthens memory, improves understanding, and helps identify weak areas early. Simple techniques like solving questions without referring to notes, taking mock tests, or explaining concepts to someone else can significantly improve retention and exam performance.

At Mayank Tutorials near Basant Park Police Station, Chembur Naka, students across SSC, ICSE, 11th & 12th Science, and 11th & 12th Commerce use structured assessments and guided learning to strengthen concepts and improve academic outcomes.

WHY REGULAR TESTS IMPROVE EXAM SCORES

Many students focus only on studying new concepts but overlook the importance of regular testing. Tests help identify weak areas, improve time management, and build confidence long before the final examination.

Regular assessments also help students become familiar with exam patterns and reduce anxiety by creating a structured learning routine. Small improvements after every test often lead to significant academic growth over time.

At Mayank Tutorials near Basant Park Police Station, Chembur Naka, students across SSC, ICSE, 11th & 12th Science, and 11th & 12th Commerce benefit from regular assessments designed to strengthen concepts and improve performance.

When Should Students Start Preparing for Board Exams?

Many students believe serious exam preparation begins a few months before boards. In reality, students who perform consistently well usually focus on understanding concepts from the start of the academic year. Regular revision, practice tests, and doubt-solving sessions help reduce stress and improve confidence closer to exams.

A common mistake is postponing revision until the syllabus is complete. This often leads to unnecessary pressure and weaker retention. Breaking preparation into smaller, manageable goals throughout the year helps students perform more effectively in examinations.

featured_reviews.name: Aggrim Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommended. Producing numerous results every year, SRM sir has a vast experience of nurturing students into IITians. Syllabus coverage is highly detailed, covering all possible variations of questions asked in JEE ADV, involving a teaching methodology which not only classifies the different types questions which can be repeated but also helps students to develop their thinking and approach to counter new questions & situations as well. Sir has mastered the art of explaining concepts through years of experience. Practice questions of progressive difficulty and standardised tests are assigned at the end of each chapter, as well as the end of the syllabus so that students can have thorough practice. Classroom interactions are personalized, with one on one doubt clearance sessions at the end of every class. Makes the IIT-JEE journey of an engineering aspirant significantly easier.

featured_reviews.name: Lakshika Aswal
featured_reviews.review_text: SRM sir has an extensive experience in coaching students for the JEE exam. His teaching style was exceptionally thorough, covering every possible concept and problem variation that could come in the exam. His explanations were so clear and fundamental that they continue to help me in my college courses to this day.

featured_reviews.name: Anjaneya Damle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently pursuing my Btech in Electrical Engineering from IIT Jodhpur, SRM Sir was one of those who played a crucial role in enabling me to reach here.
Sir focuses strongly on building up the chapter conceptually while interspersing it with appropriate amount of practice problems. Sir also has an arsenal of specific methods and tricks highly relevant to the question patterns asked in competitive exams.
Sir teaches maths at or above the level of the JEE Advanced, discussing a variety of tricky and interesting problems to help build our aptitude and interest towards problem solving.
Sir also conducts revision lectures doubt solving sessions and regular chapter wise tests, which helped us prepare for both JEE Mains and Advanced patterns.
I scored highest in maths (70) among all the three subjects in my JEE Advanced paper thanks to all the efforts of SRM Sir.
PS: Studying Permutations and Combinations from sir is one of the best experiences one will have during those JEE preparation :)

featured_reviews.name: Arun Nair (.)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Currently pursuing Instrumentation Engineering at IIT Kharagpur.
Sreenivasan sir is a quirky and talented teacher. With emphasis on understanding, visualising and then problem solving, he provided an all round experience while I learnt math. The things he taught me have helped me further at IIT as well. He was available for clearing our doubts, and his material is exceptional.  When the class became a tad monotonous, he would tell us something about his experiences. So, his sessions never became boring.
Would definitely recommend to anyone interested to learn math and develop a good interest in the subject.

featured_reviews.name: Saina Kini
featured_reviews.review_text: Sreenivasan’s IIT Academy has been an absolute game-changer for my math preparation. Sreenivasan sir breaks down complex problems into simple steps, making even the toughest topics manageable.

featured_reviews.name: Advaith Sudarshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I study in IIIT hyderabad and i can confidently say, Sreenivasan sir is truly the best teacher for mathematics when it comes to IIT JEE, he explains concepts extremely clearly and the questions he does in class are perfect for understanding and revising the topics. His tips and tricks for JEE Mains , ensures that you can solve all questions quickly and accurately, this helped me secure 80+ in Maths. And when it comes to JEE ADVANCED, sir leaves no stone unturned, the volume and quality of questions he gives us to solve along with his concise revisions will give you great confidence in mathematics.
This also helped in other engineering exams, like BITSAT where I secured 300+, and UGEE as well. So I highly recommend Sreenivasan sir for mathematics as well as an overall guide for you exam prep!

featured_reviews.name: Ark Modi
featured_reviews.review_text: I am currently studying Electrical Engineering at IIT Bombay. I was a student of Srinivasan Sir all throughout my two years of JEE preparation. In my experience, he is one of the most thorough and dedicated teachers for mathematics. His enthusiasm for both teaching and mathematics is visible in his student friendly, concept oriented  teaching style. I found Srinivasan Sirs conceptual clarity beyond compare. His insistence on the timely completion of the exhaustive booklets made me really comfortable tackling any question. It was a great experience having him as my maths teacher, and I would definitely recommend everyone to join his institute if you’re looking for a dependable and assured way to scoring well in JEE.

featured_reviews.name: Saptarshi Das
featured_reviews.review_text: I am currently studying Civil Engineering at IIT Guwahati. Sreenivasan Sir is the best teacher that a student can hope to get for Maths during his/her JEE preparation. He is a brilliant teacher with in-depth knowledge of the entire subject and can explain even the toughest concepts very easily. He is a very sincere teacher and he gives his 200 percent in making sure that the students have no issues in his subject. He is a very fun teacher and I thoroughly enjoyed attending his lectures. Even during the lockdown, sir took regular doubt lectures and made sure that our preparation was not adversely affected. I would highly recommend Sreenivasan Sir to each and every JEE aspirant out there.

Why Consistent Revision Is More Effective Than Last-Minute Studying

One of the biggest mistakes students make is leaving revision until the final few weeks before exams. While intensive studying may seem productive, consistent revision throughout the academic year leads to much better understanding, stronger retention, and greater confidence during examinations.

Breaking the syllabus into smaller goals, revisiting important concepts regularly, and solving practice questions help students identify weak areas before they become major challenges. This approach reduces stress and improves long-term academic performance.

At Mayank Tutorials near Ambedkar Garden on 16th Road, Chembur, students preparing for SSC, 11th & 12th Science, and 11th & 12th Commerce benefit from structured revision plans, regular assessments, and personalised academic guidance.

WHY ACTIVE RECALL IS ONE OF THE BEST STUDY METHODS FOR STUDENTS

Studying for long hours does not always guarantee better results. Active recall is a proven learning technique that encourages students to retrieve information from memory rather than repeatedly reading notes. This improves retention and helps students understand concepts more deeply.

Students can practise active recall through self-quizzing, solving problems, or writing answers from memory. Regular use of this method builds confidence and improves performance in both board and entrance examinations.

At Mayank Tutorials near Ambedkar Garden on 16th Road, Chembur, students enrolled in SSC, 11th & 12th Science, and 11th & 12th Commerce benefit from structured learning and regular assessments designed to improve academic performance.

WHY REGULAR TESTS IMPROVE EXAM SCORES

Regular testing is one of the most effective ways to improve academic performance. It allows students to understand their strengths, work on weak areas, and develop better exam-writing skills.

Rather than treating tests as a measure of marks alone, students should view them as opportunities to learn, improve, and build confidence before important examinations.
